LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Falcon.label: Falcon
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Falcon.description: A light tri-rotor drone for armed aerial reconnaissance and anti-tank strikes.

LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Hyrax.label: hyrax
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Hyrax.description: A remote-controlled machine gun carrier on a light tracked platform. Automatic weapons of this construction are usually the first practical product any drone arms manufacturer develops.
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Hyrax.tools.head.label: head
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Noctula.label: Noctula
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Noctula.description: A tri-rotor drone with optical stealth capability, codenamed "Noctula". It is the command-relay conversion of the Falcon, providing command chain support for jaegers on operations.
